simple.explanation: Raghav practices yoga in the morning. (a) Who took the longest time? (b) Who took the least time?
Racing Seconds Chapter Chapter 12 12 Let us find out 1.
At what time did Raghav start practising Yoga? ……………….
How much time did he spend practising Yoga? ....................
Find the time elapsed between the given time periods.
Share your strategies. (a) 01:15 p.m. to 01:42 p.m.? (b) 03:18 p.m. to 08:18 p.m.? (c) 09:15 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.?
The table below shows the time taken by 3 children to paint a picture.
Name Time Taken Raghav 1 hour 20 minutes Rani 2 hours 10 minutes Ritu 1 hour 35 minutes 1 2 3 01:55 Min.
Fill in the blanks by writing the time in the appropriate format.
Time in 12-hour fromat Time in 24-hour fromat 05:30 a.m.
14:30 hours 05:30 p.m. ……… hours 09:35 p.m. ……… hours 7.
Time in 12–hour format Time in 24–hour format 06:30 a.m.
19:30 hours Akira, Sunita, and Mary are participating in a 200 m-walking race.
157 Do you notice the use of a new unit ‘seconds’ in the picture?
1 min = 60 seconds In situations like a race, ‘seconds’ help us observe small differences in time taken by participants.
Each participant took 1 minute but how much more?
Estimate whether you would take seconds or minutes to complete the following activities.

Let Us Do Activity Seconds Minutes Blinking of eyes Switching on and switching off the lights Counting from 1–20 Filling a glass from the tap Melting of an ice-cube Making a phone call Sitting down on the floor Drinking a glass of water Snapping fingers Washing hands Note for the Teachers: Let the learners observe and discuss who stood first, who stood second, and who stood third and why.
Help them understand the difference between minutes and seconds and seconds as a unit which adds precision in measuring short time duration.
Get the learners to observe that 60 movements of the seconds hand leads to a shift in the minute hand.
Activity Estimated Number Actual Number Number of balloons blown Number of push-ups Number of breaths Number of hops on one leg 1.
Find out the number of times you can skip the rope in 10 seconds.
How long does it take you to write the word FRIEND?
159 Observe the clocks and fill in the blanks.
Let Us Do 1 Rani took __________ sec. to get out of her bed.
2 3 4 Raghav took ________ sec. to move from his room to the kitchen.
Ritu took ________ sec. to pick up a piece of paper from the floor.
Raghu took ________ sec. to wash his spoon and plate.
160 Draw the missing seconds hand on the clocks on the right side.
1 2 3 4 Raghu took 20 sec. to read a sentence in his book.
Raghav took 60 sec. to move from his home to the garden.
161 Zainab and Remo were converting time from hours to minutes and vice-versa.

(i) 1 hours 10 minutes = _____ minutes (ii) 2 hours 45 minutes = _____ minutes (iii) 3 hours 15 minutes = _____ minutes (iv) 4 hours 20 minutes = _____ minutes (v) 75 minutes = ____ hour ____ minutes (vi) 150 minutes = ____ hours ____ minutes (vii) 220 minutes = ____ hours ____ minutes (viii) 390 minutes = ____ hours ____ minutes (a) 1 hr ___ hr 4 hr 7 hr __hr 9 hr ____hr ____hr 60 min 120 min ___ min ___ min 480 min ___ min 660 min 720 min × 2
Raghav studies Mathematics, English, Hindi, and The World Around Us subjects.
He took 50 minutes to study each of the subjects.
Find the total time taken in hours and minutes.
Raghu left his house at 08:00 hours and arrived at his Nana ji’s house at 09:05 hours.
So, Raghu took 1 hour 5 minutes to reach his Nana ji’s house. (c) Fill in the blanks in the double number line to complete the conversions.

1 min ___min 5 min 10 min 15 min ___min ___min 60 sec 120 sec ___ sec ___ sec ___ sec 1200 sec 1500 sec (i) 320 sec = ____ min ____ sec (ii) 225 sec = ____ min ____ sec (iii) 700 sec = ____ min ____ sec (iv) 1,000 sec = ____ min ____ sec (v) 10 min 13 sec = ____ sec (vi) 4 min 8 sec = ____ sec (vii) 15 min 40 sec = ____ sec × 5 × 60
Ragini took 1 hour 10 minutes to do her homework.
A group of children left for a picnic at 08:30 AM.
She finished her homework in 1 hour 30 minutes.
Alya goes out to play at 05:30 PM and comes back after 1 hour 10 minutes.
If the lunch break of a school starts at 12:30 PM and ends in 35 minutes, what time will lunch end?
What time will it be after 8 hours and 25 minutes?
Note for the Teachers: Encourage learners to solve these problems orally and not by aligning them in columns and using algorithms.
